name: Logic & Reasoning
description: Multi-step deduction, constraint puzzles and planning problems written fresh for Gauntlet, so they cannot have been memorised.

name: Mathematics
description: Competition-style arithmetic, algebra, combinatorics and probability with a single verifiable numeric answer.

name: Coding
description: Write real functions that are executed against hidden unit tests in a sandbox. Only passing tests count.

name: Instruction Following
description: Precise, machine-verifiable formatting and content constraints (word counts, forbidden letters, acrostics, JSON shapes).

name: Honesty & Calibration
description: The Honesty Trap: false premises, fabricated entities and unanswerable questions mixed with real ones. Confident nonsense is punished.

name: Long Context & Memory
description: Needles in a generated novel, multi-hop recall across tens of thousands of tokens, and information decay across rewrites.

name: Agents & Planning
description: Seeded simulations — Survival Island, Escape Room, Startup — where the model acts turn by turn and lives with its decisions.

name: Social Deduction
description: The Liar's Table: interrogate suspects, find the contradiction, name the liar with the fewest questions.

name: Visual & Spatial
description: Draw It Blind and SVG construction: describe and rebuild scenes, scored geometrically.

name: Creative Building
description: One-shot playable games and interactive pages, auto-tested in a headless browser and judged against a rubric.

name: Data Extraction
description: Turn messy real-world text into exact structured JSON. Every field is checked.

name: Can It Be Fooled?
description: Famous puzzles with one detail changed, questions built on false premises and 30-second lightning traps. Every answer is graded exactly: pattern-matching gets punished.
